description: This Java source file defines an Android activity demonstrating how to implement accessibility support for custom views, including examples of inheritance-based and composition-based approaches to accessibility enhancements. It also contains a custom toggle button class with accessibility considerations.

classes.name: CustomViewAccessibilityActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating accessibility support for custom views, including inner classes for enhanced accessibility via inheritance and composition, as well as a customizable toggle button.

classes.name: AccessibleCompoundButtonInheritance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseToggleButton demonstrating accessibility support via inheritance, overriding accessibility-related methods to improve assistive technology interaction.

classes.name: AccessibleCompoundButtonComposition
classes.description: A subclass of BaseToggleButton that uses an AccessibilityDelegate to add accessibility support via composition, supporting backward compatibility.

classes.name: BaseToggleButton
classes.description: A basic custom toggle button view with on/off text, layout logic, and a boolean checked state. It serves as a base class to demonstrate accessibility enhancements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: tryInstallAccessibilityDelegate
methods.description: Sets an accessibility delegate to the custom view if the API level supports it, to enhance accessibility support.

methods.name: onInitializeAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Overrides accessibility event initialization to include toggle state information.

methods.name: onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo
methods.description: Overrides node info initialization to include checkable and checked states, and text support.

methods.name: onPopulateAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Populates accessibility event with the current text of the custom view.

methods.name: performClick
methods.description: Handles click events to toggle the checked state.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the size required for the custom toggle button based on text layouts.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the toggle button's text based on the current checked state.
